name: homebase
description: Local-first, mobile-first control plane for AI coding agents running on your own computer.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @homebase/protocol && npm run build -w @homebase/adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @homebase/adapter-opencode && npm run build -w @homebase/host
